notes: intronIC v3.0.0 default model: raw-feature pmotif_adjudicated architecture. A single calibrated RBF-SVM ensemble (42 sub-models / 210 sub-estimators, C=200 gamma=0.001, isotonic) scores the 6 background-corrected RAW motif features -> per-intron ensemble margin -> P_motif (species-agnostic, Platt-calibrated). All per-species adaptation lives in the output-level species adjudicator: z_excess gap gate (anchors loss_ceiling_z=2.60 / bearer_floor_z=5.50) + per-genome strength gate (p_gumbel_p95<=0.01, cs_p95>=5.0 co-fallback) -> motif_category {DETECTED, INCONCLUSIVE, NOT_DETECTED, UNASSESSABLE}. Call rule: type_id=u12 iff P_motif>=0.5 (adjusted_score>=50) AND motif_category!=NOT_DETECTED. This supersedes the v2.5-2.7 z-normalization + mode-separation + continuous-discount stack. See docs/raw_gated_scoring.md and docs/adjudicator_design.md.
